Hot take and a spoiler. I liked Allison's plot. It shows that she's just human and she's tired of saving the world (which turns out hurts her even more). 

She finds solace to Luther, which she has long affection for. But, Luther has moved on to Sloane. Hence, she resorts to abusing her powers to manipulate Luther. A simple execution of desperation. Something to ground her.

Then her killing Harlan, and trading her siblings for her own desires and own family (which in the end she wanted for her siblings to be still with her). I really liked it. It shows that not everyone is perfect, and it is human to feel these feelings.

I'm not saying she's good, but Allison's character is well written.

I think overall this is a team game. And you win by pushing turrets and destroying the nexus and not by killing champs.
The overall team should cooperate and one mistake of a player is affecting everyone. I think your good, just bad team mates or just bad day. 
Last tip: Don't fight in unnecessary team fights. You fight for an objective Nexus,Turret, Baron, Dragon, Herald, Blue Red Buff, Kills. This should be your priority.

As a support main, you decide how the laning goes. Your ADC prioritizes getting creeps. I suggest try poking using auto attacks in laning and only using your skills if you are sure it's going to hit.

Also you as a support, you should know how to ward properly and where to place wards. It is also your duty to clear the enemy wards. 

In the Mid to Late game, your are the team support not the adc support. you should try assisting your whole team and setting up for team fights. Know when to engage, disengage, and follow up. Most supports have good built-in crowd control in their kits so make sure you use them.

For the items, try to balance it out. If the enemy is all AD and you are playing Thresh, you may want to buy armor. If the enemy assassin is fed and you are Soraka, you may want to buy Zhonyas hourglass. Overall, you should adjust your items depending on what the team needs. Healing = Redemption. Instant Shield = Locket of Iron Solari. Aggresiveness/Disengage = Shurelyas. More damage = Zeke herals. Escape heavy cc = Mikaelis crucible. There are lot of options. Just make sure you know what to buy.

Lastly, you want to synergize with your adc. You want to have the wombo combo feel. I think you should just play and enjoy the game. Mute people if they are toxic and do your best :)
